sloka: एवमुक्तस्तदा राजा महापार्श्वएन रावणः ।तस्य सम्पूजयन्वाक्यमिदम् वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-१३-९॥।।
transliteration: evamuktastadā rājā mahāpārśvaena rāvaṇaḥ ।tasya sampūjayanvākyamidam vacanamabravīt ॥6-13-9॥।।

translations.english: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas feeling happy about the statement of Mahaparsva, spoke these words.
